text.tspan: Helm 4 server-side apply: every field has an owner (metadata.managedFields)
Helm (Apply) owns every field it sends
A normal write that changes a value takes the name tag
3 · helm upgrade with the same values
The API server checks the tags → conflict, the upgrade fails
Rule: the only owner stops sending a field → it is DELETED
Tested: the chart stopped setting replicas while Helm was the
only owner → replicas 3 → 1, and the HPA restored 4 about
15 seconds later. Let the HPA own the field first, then remove it.
Helm 3 way (apply_method = csa) never checks the tags
It sends a normal Update, so replicas silently goes back to 3.
Each release Secret stores apply_method (ssa or csa), and
--server-side=auto reuses it on the next upgrade.
